title: Tasty evening
text:
We had a knowledgeable guide who was very friendly. A had a good variety of different foods in different places. 5 people on our tour and we all enjoyed it.
It is not just the food but seeing areas we would not normally find on our own.
author: steve_w

title: Go with Vincent
text: Vincent was great tour guide. We tasted many things that we would not have discovered on our own or through the guide book. And he provided a lot of additional information and suggestions.
author: Virginia_S

title: Nice Introduction to Barcelona
text: We planned the street food tour at 5 PM to help us stay awake on our arrival day in Barcelona and it did just that. We had Sofia as our tour guide and she did an exceptional job with our small group. We spent time in La Boqueria market and several shops around the area. I won’t spoil the menu. Sofia shared info on all the interesting spots we passed through such as the Gothic section and aligned the food tasting as if she were a chef. There is reasonable walking and the tasty treats are worth. There was enough food that my family called it a night.
author: V0617TNL

title: History and food
text: Amazing guide Vincenzo knowledge of history and food was a great blend. Variety of foods great with a truly local flavour. Would certainly recommend. We went back the next day to the market for more paella!
author: Elisabeth_P

title: Surprisingly it wasn’t only about the food.
text: Future travelers will be in for treat of local foods that are only are found in this region of Spain. Sophia, our guide expert, was a local to this region who knew the history of all the foods we tasted. She was very personable, funny, and professional. Best tour we have been on. bar none.
author: Elizabeth_P

title: Yummy & informative tour - we loved it!
text: This walking food tour was delicious & informative. Our tour guide knew just where to take us but still modified our small group tour enough that we each got to go where we wanted. The food selection was perfect & the buying tips & suggestions were spot on. We had a fabulous time.
author: Teresa T

title: Excellent
text: Sofia was an exceptional guide. Very knowledgeable with lots of historical facts and we saw many sights but she also pointed out many things we would have missed! Loved the variety of food and the fact we could shop as we went. Excellent tour and lovely guide.
author: K1271QGsarab

title: Barcelona food market tour
text: A very enjoyable tour with our guide Vince who was knowledgeable, friendly and set a relaxed pace for everyone. And the food was delicious. I would recommend
author: NeginM

title: Two and a half hours of deliciousness
text: We stopped at five different spots throughout the gothic area in the main market and through a few side streets including olives, paella, chocolate, patisserie, and smoked ham.Vincent gave us history about the food and the city along the walk and the entire tour took about two and a half hours
author: Jared_A

title: Gastronomically and Intellectually Enriching
text: The Tasty Tour of Barcelona with Vincent was outstanding!  While we had been in Barcelona for a couple days, Vincent provided us with valuable context and knowledge about the Barcelona cuisine, took us to fantastic stops and shared recommendations for specific meals (Tapas and Steak) that we were interested in.  Vincent also educated us on the history of Barcelona during our tour.  We left well fed and wiser! A truly enriching experience!
author: M4757THjonm
